words.enDefinition: Tasks done to get ingredients ready before making a dish

examples.en: We split the prep work so everyone could join the study group later.
examples.zh: 我们分担了「备料工作」，这样晚些时候大家都能参加学习小组。

examples.en: The recipe estimates how long the prep work takes before cooking begins.
examples.zh: 菜谱估算了开始做菜前的「备料工作」需要多长时间。

words.enDefinition: A designated area for preparing ingredients and organizing kitchen tools

examples.en: I used the far end of the counter as my prep station.
examples.zh: 我把操作台另一端当作自己的「备料台」。

examples.en: The prep station held our bowls and the ingredients for lunch.
examples.zh: 「备料台」上放着我们的碗和做午饭用的食材。

words.enDefinition: Ingredients and equipment arranged in advance for preparing a dish

examples.en: The tutor checked our mise en place before we started making the dressing.
examples.zh: 指导老师在我们调酱汁前检查了食材是否「备齐并摆好」。

examples.en: I used a tray to keep my mise en place together beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我用托盘把「备齐并摆好」的食材集中放在菜谱旁。

collocations: set up your mise en place
a tray for mise en place

words.enDefinition: A small bowl for holding prepared or measured ingredients

examples.en: I put the chopped herbs in a prep bowl beside my plate.
examples.zh: 我把切好的香草放在盘子旁的「备料小碗」里。

examples.en: The prep bowl was too small for the amount of onion we needed.
examples.zh: 「备料小碗」太小，装不下我们需要的洋葱。

words.enDefinition: To cut food into pieces without making them small or even

examples.en: The soup recipe says to chop roughly because the vegetables will be blended.
examples.zh: 汤的菜谱上说蔬菜最后会打碎，所以先「粗切」就行。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to chop roughly in the salad recipe.
examples.zh: 我问沙拉菜谱里说的「粗切」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: To cut an ingredient into many very small pieces

examples.en: The recipe says to finely chop the onion for the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，要把做馅用的洋葱「剁碎」。

examples.en: We forgot to finely chop the herbs before adding them to the bowl.
examples.zh: 我们忘了把香草「剁碎」，就直接放进了碗里。

words.enDefinition: To cut food into pieces with very little thickness

examples.en: I asked whether to slice thinly or leave the pieces a little thicker.
examples.zh: 我问是要「切成薄片」，还是把片切厚一点。

examples.en: For the salad, the recipe says to slice thinly rather than cut into cubes.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱要求「切成薄片」，别切成方丁。

words.enDefinition: To divide a round food into pieces with pointed centers

examples.en: The limes had already been cut into wedges when I arrived to help.
examples.zh: 我到厨房帮忙时，青柠已经被「切成楔形块」了。

examples.en: I checked which fruit should be cut into wedges for the platter.
examples.zh: 我核对了果盘里哪种水果应该「切成楔形块」。

words.enDefinition: To divide food into fairly large pieces for a dish

examples.en: The vegetable stew recipe said the carrots should be cut into chunks.
examples.zh: 蔬菜炖菜的菜谱说，胡萝卜要「切成大块」。

examples.en: The pumpkin was already cut into chunks when my flatmate brought it home.
examples.zh: 室友带回家的南瓜已经「切成大块」了。

words.enDefinition: To divide food into pieces shaped like small boxes

examples.en: The instructions asked for firm tofu already cut into cubes for the salad.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求沙拉用已经「切成方丁」的硬豆腐。

examples.en: I picked up a pack of cheese that was already cut into cubes.
examples.zh: 我买了一盒已经「切成方丁」的奶酪。

collocations: cut into cubes for a salad

words.enDefinition: To cut vegetables or fruit into thin matchstick-shaped pieces

examples.en: The recipe says to julienne the carrots before mixing the salad.
examples.zh: 菜谱说胡萝卜要「切成细条」，然后再拌沙拉。

examples.en: My roommate asked what it meant to julienne a cucumber.
examples.zh: 室友问，把黄瓜「切成细条」具体指什么样的切法。

words.enDefinition: To slice meat across the direction of its muscle fibers

examples.en: The recipe says to cut across the grain when slicing the beef for sandwiches.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，把牛肉切片夹三明治时要「横着纹理切」。

examples.en: I asked whether the arrows in the picture meant to cut across the grain.
examples.zh: 我问图里的箭头是不是表示要「横着纹理切」。

collocations: cut across the grain for serving
cut across the grain of the beef
remember to cut across the grain

words.enDefinition: To cut garlic into very small pieces for a recipe

examples.en: The recipe says to mince garlic before mixing it with the yogurt.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，把蒜拌入酸奶前要先「把大蒜剁成末」。

examples.en: My flatmate volunteered to mince garlic while I got the bowls ready.
examples.zh: 我在准备碗的时候，室友主动提出帮我「把大蒜剁成末」。

words.enDefinition: To divide something into two equal or nearly equal parts

examples.en: I read the recipe twice before deciding which tomatoes to halve.
examples.zh: 我看了两遍菜谱，才弄清楚该把哪些番茄「对半切开」。

examples.en: My roommate asked if she should halve the lemons for us.
examples.zh: 室友问她要不要帮大家把柠檬「对半切开」。

words.enDefinition: To remove the outer tips from a vegetable or similar ingredient

examples.en: The recipe says to trim the ends of the green beans before measuring them.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，称四季豆之前要「切掉两端」。

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to trim the ends of the scallions first.
examples.zh: 我问是不是得先给小葱「切掉两端」。

collocations: trim the ends of the beans

words.enDefinition: To separate stems from the usable parts of an ingredient

examples.en: Our salad recipe says to remove the stems from the mushrooms first.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱上说，蘑菇要先「去掉梗」。

examples.en: I offered to remove the stems from the herbs while my roommate measured oil.
examples.zh: 室友在量油的时候，我主动提出帮香草「去掉梗」。

words.enDefinition: To remove the central part of an apple containing seeds

examples.en: The recipe shows a photo of a tool to core an apple.
examples.zh: 菜谱上有一张工具照片，展示的是用来「去掉苹果核」的工具。

examples.en: The teaching assistant showed us which tool to use to core an apple.
examples.zh: 助教给我们看了用什么工具可以「去掉苹果核」。

collocations: core an apple for a snack
core an apple for a tart
a tool to core an apple

words.enDefinition: To remove the hard stones from cherries before using them

examples.en: I forgot the recipe said to pit the cherries before filling the bowl.
examples.zh: 我忘了菜谱上说，往碗里放之前要先「去掉樱桃核」。

examples.en: My roommate brought a tool to pit the cherries for our dessert.
examples.zh: 室友带了个工具，把甜点要用的樱桃「去掉核」。

collocations: pit the cherries for a pie
a tool to pit the cherries

words.enDefinition: To remove the green tops and attached cores from strawberries

examples.en: I asked whether the recipe expected us to hull strawberries for the topping.
examples.zh: 我问菜谱是不是要求把做表面装饰的草莓「去掉草莓蒂」。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated what it meant to hull strawberries in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 老师在厨房里给我们演示了「去掉草莓蒂」指的是什么。

words.enDefinition: To remove seeds from a fruit, vegetable, or other ingredient

examples.en: The recipe says to deseed the peppers before adding them to the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，把甜椒放进馅里之前要先「去籽」。

examples.en: I asked whether we should deseed the cucumber for this salad.
examples.zh: 我问做这份沙拉时，黄瓜要不要「去籽」。

words.enDefinition: To divide food into many long, thin pieces or strips

examples.en: The recipe says to shred the cabbage for the sandwich filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，要把夹三明治的卷心菜「切成细丝」。

examples.en: I used a grater to shred the carrots for our salad.
examples.zh: 我用擦丝器把做沙拉的胡萝卜「切成细丝」。

words.enDefinition: To remove the thin, colored outside layer of a lemon

examples.en: We needed a fine grater to zest a lemon for the cake.
examples.zh: 我们做蛋糕时需要细刨，好「刨取柠檬外皮」。

examples.en: The recipe says to zest a lemon before measuring the juice for the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，量馅料用的柠檬汁之前先「刨取柠檬外皮」。

collocations: zest a lemon for a cake
a tool to zest a lemon

words.enDefinition: To press fruit so the liquid inside it comes out

examples.en: We put a bowl underneath to squeeze the juice without losing any liquid.
examples.zh: 我们在下面放了个碗，准备「挤出果汁」，免得汁液洒出来。

examples.en: My roommate offered to squeeze the juice from the last two limes.
examples.zh: 室友主动提出帮我从最后两个青柠里「挤出果汁」。

collocations: squeeze the juice from a lemon
squeeze the juice into a bowl

words.enDefinition: To press one segment of garlic until it breaks apart

examples.en: I needed the small press to crush a garlic clove for the dressing.
examples.zh: 我要用那个小压蒜器「压碎一瓣大蒜」，用来调酱汁。

examples.en: The recipe says to crush a garlic clove before adding the yogurt.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，放酸奶之前要先「压碎一瓣大蒜」。

collocations: crush a garlic clove for dressing
use a press to crush a garlic clove
crush a garlic clove for a marinade

words.enDefinition: To crush soft food into a thick and mostly uniform mixture

examples.en: I used a fork to mash the banana for the batter.
examples.zh: 我用叉子把香蕉「捣成泥」，拿去拌面糊。

examples.en: The recipe says to mash the avocado before adding the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，加入柠檬汁之前要把牛油果「捣成泥」。

words.enDefinition: To break spices into smaller pieces by repeatedly pressing or striking them

examples.en: We borrowed a mortar to pound spices for the class recipe.
examples.zh: 我们借来研钵，把课堂菜谱用的香料「捣碎」。

examples.en: My flatmate offered to pound spices while I checked the ingredient list.
examples.zh: 室友主动帮忙「捣碎香料」，我来核对食材清单。

words.enDefinition: To take small bones out of a piece of fish

examples.en: Our instructor explained why some cooks still remove the fillet bones after buying fish.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么有些人买来鱼后仍会「剔除鱼柳里的鱼刺」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fishmonger could remove the fillet bones at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问鱼柜店员能不能在柜台帮我「剔除鱼柳里的鱼刺」。

collocations: remove the fillet bones before portioning
a tool to remove the fillet bones

words.enDefinition: To remove surface moisture by pressing gently with something absorbent

examples.en: The recipe asked us to pat dry the herbs before chopping them.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求切香草之前先「轻拍吸干」表面水分。

examples.en: My flatmate asked how much moisture would remain after we pat dry the leaves.
examples.zh: 室友问把叶子「轻拍吸干」后，还会剩多少水分。

words.enDefinition: To let unwanted liquid run away from food or ingredients

examples.en: The instructions say to drain off the liquid before mixing the beans.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，拌豆子之前先「沥去液体」。

examples.en: I asked which bowl would catch the liquid we needed to drain off.
examples.zh: 我问要用哪个碗来接「沥去的液体」。

collocations: drain off the liquid from a can

words.enDefinition: To combine ingredients using quick movements with a whisk

examples.en: I checked which ingredients to whisk together before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 我核对了在加面粉前要把哪些食材「一起搅打」。

examples.en: The recipe says to whisk together the eggs and milk first.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先把鸡蛋和牛奶「一起搅打」。

words.enDefinition: To add an ingredient to a mixture by stirring it

examples.en: I almost forgot to stir in the lemon juice at the end.
examples.zh: 我差点忘了最后把柠檬汁「搅拌加入」。

examples.en: The note tells us when to stir in the remaining flour.
examples.zh: 备注告诉我们什么时候把剩余的面粉「搅拌加入」。

words.enDefinition: To incorporate an ingredient while keeping a light mixture airy

examples.en: The cake recipe says to fold in the beaten egg whites.
examples.zh: 蛋糕菜谱上说，要把打发的蛋白「轻轻翻拌加入」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how the term fold in differs from vigorous mixing.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「轻轻翻拌加入」这个说法和用力搅拌有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: To mix ingredients briefly with small, quick movements

examples.en: The recipe says to beat lightly until you can no longer see streaks.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，要「轻轻搅打」，直到看不出颜色深浅不同的条纹。

examples.en: We checked whether the recipe said to beat lightly or whisk vigorously.
examples.zh: 我们核对了菜谱说的是「轻轻搅打」还是用力搅打。

words.enDefinition: To move ingredients together until they form a single mixture

examples.en: I checked what stir until combined meant before preparing the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 我在调沙拉酱之前查了「搅拌至混合均匀」是什么意思。

examples.en: The recipe says to stir until combined before pouring the mixture into the dish.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先「搅拌至混合均匀」，再把混合物倒进盘里。

collocations: stir until combined after each addition
the instruction to stir until combined

words.enDefinition: To combine ingredients until the mixture has no noticeable lumps

examples.en: Our recipe says to mix until smooth before adding the remaining milk.
examples.zh: 我们的菜谱说，加剩余牛奶之前先「拌至顺滑」。

examples.en: I asked how the mixture should look after we mix until smooth.
examples.zh: 我问「拌至顺滑」之后，混合物应是什么样子。

collocations: mix until smooth with a spatula
mix until smooth before adding more
the instruction to mix until smooth

words.enDefinition: To gently mix pieces so their surfaces receive an even covering

examples.en: The salad recipe says to toss to coat once the dressing is added.
examples.zh: 沙拉菜谱上说，倒入酱汁后要「拌匀使表面裹上」酱汁。

examples.en: We used the larger bowl to toss to coat without spilling the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们用大一点的碗「拌匀使表面裹上」酱汁，免得蔬菜洒出来。

collocations: toss to coat in a bowl

words.enDefinition: To work solid fat into dry ingredients until they resemble crumbs

examples.en: The pastry recipe says to rub in the butter before adding water.
examples.zh: 酥皮菜谱说，加水之前把黄油「搓散拌入」面粉。

examples.en: The teacher explained what rub in meant in the original recipe.
examples.zh: 老师解释了原菜谱里的「搓散拌入」是什么意思。

collocations: instructions for how to rub in

words.enDefinition: To beat butter and sugar together until light and fluffy

examples.en: The recipe says to cream butter and sugar before mixing in the egg.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，拌入鸡蛋之前先「将黄油和糖打发」。

examples.en: I checked why the instructions said to cream butter and sugar for this cake.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，这款蛋糕为什么要求「将黄油和糖打发」。

collocations: cream butter and sugar until fluffy
use a mixer to cream butter and sugar

words.enDefinition: To handle and shape dough until it reaches a desired texture

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we needed to work the dough any longer.
examples.zh: 室友问我们还要不要继续「揉整面团」。

examples.en: The teacher said to work the dough just enough to bring it together.
examples.zh: 老师说，只要「揉整面团」到能够成团就可以。

collocations: work the dough on a board

words.enDefinition: To leave a prepared mixture of flour and liquid undisturbed

examples.en: The recipe says to let the dough rest while we prepare the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，准备馅料时可以「让面团静置」。

examples.en: I asked why we needed to let the dough rest before shaping it.
examples.zh: 我问为什么整形之前要「让面团静置」。

collocations: let the dough rest before shaping
let the dough rest in the bowl
let the dough rest on the counter

words.enDefinition: To form pieces of a mixture into round shapes

examples.en: The recipe says the pieces should be shaped into balls before assembly.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，这些小块要先「做成球形」，再进行组装。

examples.en: I asked whether to shape into balls or flatten the mixture instead.
examples.zh: 我问要把混合物「做成球形」，还是压扁。

collocations: shape into balls of equal size

words.enDefinition: To separate food into quantities for individual servings or uses

examples.en: I asked how we should divide into portions for the six students.
examples.zh: 我问，给六位同学要怎样把食物「分成若干份」。

examples.en: The recipe says to divide into portions before adding the toppings.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，先「分成若干份」，再加表面的配料。

words.enDefinition: To pass flour through a sieve to remove lumps

examples.en: I borrowed a fine sieve to sift flour for the cake.
examples.zh: 我借了一个细筛子，准备给蛋糕「过筛面粉」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we needed to sift flour for this recipe.
examples.zh: 室友问我们这道菜谱要不要「过筛面粉」。

words.expression: make a well in the center
words.lemma: make a well in the center
words.enDefinition: To create a hollow in the middle of dry ingredients
acceptedEnVariants: make a well in the center
make a well in the centre

examples.en: The card says to make a well in the center once the flour is in the bowl.
examples.zh: 菜谱卡上说，面粉放进碗里后要「在中间挖个凹坑」。

examples.en: I checked whether to make a well in the center before adding the eggs.
examples.zh: 我核对了加鸡蛋之前是否要「在中间挖个凹坑」。

collocations: make a well in the center of the flour
make a well in the center before pouring
use a spoon to make a well in the center

words.enDefinition: To cover a surface lightly with a small amount of flour

examples.en: The recipe says to dust with flour before rolling out the pastry.
examples.zh: 菜谱上说，擀酥皮前要「薄撒一层面粉」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the work surface to dust with flour.
examples.zh: 我问操作台的哪部分要「薄撒一层面粉」。

words.enDefinition: Dough that clings noticeably to hands, utensils, or other surfaces

examples.en: The sticky dough clung to the sides of our mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 「发黏的面团」粘在我们的搅拌碗内壁上。

examples.en: My flatmate wondered why this particular recipe always produced sticky dough.
examples.zh: 室友问为什么这份菜谱做出来的是「发黏的面团」。

words.enDefinition: A flour-based mixture thin enough to pour or spread easily

examples.en: A little more milk gave us a loose batter for the pancakes.
examples.zh: 多加了一点牛奶后，我们得到了做薄饼用的「稀面糊」。

examples.en: The recipe photo showed a loose batter running off the spoon.
examples.zh: 菜谱照片里的「稀面糊」正从勺子上往下流。

words.enDefinition: A mixture of flour and liquid that flows only slowly

examples.en: The muffins needed a thick batter that would stay on the spoon.
examples.zh: 做玛芬需要能挂在勺子上的「稠面糊」。

examples.en: I checked whether the thick batter in my bowl matched the photo.
examples.zh: 我核对了碗里的「稠面糊」是不是和照片里的一样。

words.enDefinition: A mixture in which all visible lumps have been broken up

examples.en: The recipe photo showed a lump-free mixture before the cocoa was added.
examples.zh: 菜谱照片展示了加可可粉之前「无结块的混合物」。

examples.en: I compared our lump-free mixture with the picture on the recipe page.
examples.zh: 我把我们的「无结块的混合物」和菜谱页上的图片作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Soft points that droop when whipped cream or egg whites are lifted

examples.en: The instructor showed how to recognize soft peaks in the mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 老师示范了如何辨认搅拌碗里的「软尖峰」。

examples.en: The picture of soft peaks showed the tip bending over slightly.
examples.zh: 「软尖峰」的图片显示顶端轻轻弯了下去。

collocations: beat the cream to soft peaks

words.enDefinition: Firm points that stay upright in whipped cream or egg whites

examples.en: I checked the recipe photo to see how stiff peaks should look.
examples.zh: 我看了菜谱照片，确认「硬尖峰」应该是什么样子。

examples.en: Our tutor showed the difference between stiff peaks and the earlier stage.
examples.zh: 老师展示了「硬尖峰」和前一阶段的区别。

collocations: whisk egg whites to stiff peaks

words.enDefinition: To adjust seasonings according to how you want food to taste

examples.en: The dressing recipe says to season to taste after adding the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 调酱汁的菜谱说，加了柠檬汁之后再「按口味调味」。

examples.en: I asked what season to taste meant in the instructions for the dip.
examples.zh: 我问蘸酱的做法里写的「按口味调味」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Solid ingredients such as flour or sugar in a baking recipe

examples.en: We put the dry ingredients in a separate bowl beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我们把「干性食材」装进另一个碗，放在菜谱旁边。

examples.en: The recipe said to combine the dry ingredients before adding any milk.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，加牛奶之前先把「干性食材」混合。

collocations: a bowl for the dry ingredients

words.enDefinition: Liquid or moist recipe ingredients usually mixed separately before combining

examples.en: I checked which of the wet ingredients belonged in the smaller bowl.
examples.zh: 我核对了哪些「湿性食材」应该放在较小的碗里。

examples.en: The wet ingredients included mashed banana as well as milk and eggs.
examples.zh: 「湿性食材」包括香蕉泥，也包括牛奶和鸡蛋。

words.enDefinition: Butter that has softened to the temperature of the room

examples.en: The cake recipe called for room-temperature butter instead of butter from the fridge.
examples.zh: 蛋糕菜谱要用「室温软化黄油」，不用刚从冰箱取出的黄油。

examples.en: The room-temperature butter was soft enough to mix with a wooden spoon.
examples.zh: 「室温软化黄油」已经软到可以用木勺搅拌了。

collocations: a recipe calling for room-temperature butter

words.enDefinition: A flavored liquid used to season food before it is cooked

examples.en: I mixed the marinade while my flatmate checked the recipe.
examples.zh: 我调「腌汁」时，室友在核对菜谱。

examples.en: The marinade for the tofu included soy sauce and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 豆腐用的「腌汁」里有酱油和柠檬汁。

words.enDefinition: To cover food lightly with flour before the next preparation step

examples.en: The preparation card says to dredge in flour before the next step.
examples.zh: 备料卡上说，下一步前要先「薄裹面粉」。

examples.en: I asked which pieces the recipe said to dredge in flour first.
examples.zh: 我问菜谱说的是哪几块要先「薄裹面粉」。

words.enDefinition: An outer layer made from small pieces of dried bread

examples.en: The recipe showed the breadcrumb coating in a separate shallow dish.
examples.zh: 菜谱展示了另一个浅盘里的「面包糠外层」。

examples.en: I checked whether the breadcrumb coating had already been added to the tofu.
examples.zh: 我核对了豆腐是否已经裹上「面包糠外层」。

words.enDefinition: To squeeze excess liquid from a block of tofu

examples.en: The recipe mentions a tool to press tofu before slicing it.
examples.zh: 菜谱提到，切片之前可以用个工具「压出豆腐里的水」。

examples.en: My roommate asked why the instructions said to press tofu for this dish.
examples.zh: 室友问这道菜为什么要「压出豆腐里的水」。

words.enDefinition: To move mixture from the sides of a bowl back into it

examples.en: The baker told us to scrape down the sides before adding the rest of the flour.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在加入剩余面粉前「把碗壁上的材料刮下」。

examples.en: I looked for a spatula to scrape down the sides between additions.
examples.zh: 每次加料的间隙，我都想找把刮刀「把碗壁上的材料刮下」。

collocations: scrape down the sides of the bowl
use a spatula to scrape down the sides
stop to scrape down the sides

words.enDefinition: The amount of food a recipe is expected to produce

examples.en: I checked the recipe yield before deciding how much flour to buy.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「菜谱成品量」，再决定买多少面粉。

examples.en: The recipe yield gave us enough for dinner and tomorrow's lunch.
examples.zh: 按「菜谱成品量」，我们做的够吃晚饭和明天的午饭。

words.enDefinition: A list of the items needed to make a recipe

examples.en: We checked the ingredient list before heading to the campus grocery store.
examples.zh: 去学校的食品杂货店之前，我们核对了「食材清单」。

examples.en: The ingredient list showed the amount of flour needed for each batch.
examples.zh: 「食材清单」写明每一批需要多少面粉。

words.enDefinition: The time needed to prepare ingredients and tools before cooking

examples.en: I read the prep time before inviting my flatmate to help.
examples.zh: 我先看了「备料时间」，再请室友过来帮忙。

examples.en: The recipe gave separate estimates for prep time and cooking time.
examples.zh: 菜谱分别估算了「备料时间」和烹饪时间。

words.enDefinition: To use twice each listed amount to make more food

examples.en: We decided to double the recipe when two more friends joined us.
examples.zh: 又有两个朋友要来，我们决定「把菜谱用量翻倍」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether to double the recipe for the club lunch.
examples.zh: 室友问给社团准备午饭时，要不要「把菜谱用量翻倍」。

words.enDefinition: To use half each listed amount to make less food

examples.en: I decided to halve the recipe because we had only one small bowl.
examples.zh: 我们只有一个小碗，所以我决定「把菜谱用量减半」。

examples.en: We asked the instructor whether we could halve the recipe for practice.
examples.zh: 我们问老师练习时可不可以「把菜谱用量减半」。

words.enDefinition: To express ingredient amounts in a different system of units

examples.en: We used the chart to convert the measurements in the American recipe.
examples.zh: 我们用对照表给这份美国菜谱「换算计量单位」。

examples.en: I asked my roommate to convert the measurements before starting the batter.
examples.zh: 我请室友在开始调面糊之前先「换算计量单位」。

collocations: convert the measurements to metric units

words.enDefinition: Quantities expressed in units such as grams or milliliters

examples.en: I switched to the recipe's metric measurements because our scale displays grams.
examples.zh: 我们的秤显示克数，所以我改按菜谱上的「公制用量」来量。

examples.en: The note gave metric measurements beside the amounts in cups.
examples.zh: 备注在以杯为单位的用量旁列出了「公制用量」。

words.enDefinition: To determine ingredient amounts using a scale rather than container volume

examples.en: The baking tutor showed how to measure by weight when preparing flour.
examples.zh: 烘焙老师示范了备面粉时怎样「按重量称量」。

examples.en: My roommate prefers to measure by weight because our measuring cups are missing.
examples.zh: 我们的量杯找不到了，室友更愿意「按重量称量」。

collocations: measure by weight on a scale

words.enDefinition: To determine an amount by the space it occupies

examples.en: The recipe says we can measure by volume if our scale is unavailable.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，没有秤时可以「按体积量取」。

examples.en: I asked why one version used grams and another said to measure by volume.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有的版本用克数，有的说要「按体积量取」。

collocations: measure by volume with a cup
measure by volume for the recipe

words.enDefinition: To use a scale to get the specified amount of flour

examples.en: We used the kitchen scale to weigh out the flour for the dough.
examples.zh: 我们用厨房秤给面团「称出所需面粉」。

examples.en: My roommate offered to weigh out the flour while I checked the recipe.
examples.zh: 我核对菜谱时，室友主动帮我「称出所需面粉」。

collocations: weigh out the flour for the dough
use a scale to weigh out the flour

words.enDefinition: The amount that fills a measuring tablespoon exactly to its rim

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe meant a level tablespoon of sugar.
examples.zh: 我核对了菜谱说的是不是一「平汤匙量」的糖。

examples.en: The tutor showed us what a level tablespoon of cocoa looked like.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了一「平汤匙量」可可粉是什么样子。

words.enDefinition: A measuring tablespoon filled with an amount mounding above its rim

examples.en: The British recipe asked for a heaped tablespoon of cocoa powder.
examples.zh: 这份英国菜谱要求舀「满尖一汤匙」可可粉。

examples.en: My flatmate asked how a heaped tablespoon differed from a level one.
examples.zh: 室友问「满尖一汤匙」和平汤匙量有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: An amount slightly smaller than a full measuring teaspoon

examples.en: The recipe lists a scant teaspoon of ground cinnamon for the filling.
examples.zh: 菜谱上写着，做馅要放「略少于一茶匙」的肉桂粉。

examples.en: We checked what a scant teaspoon meant before measuring the spice.
examples.zh: 量香料之前，我们查了「略少于一茶匙」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: To make dry ingredients even with the rim of a measure

examples.en: The tutor explained what it means to level off the top of the cup.
examples.zh: 老师解释了给量杯「刮平顶部」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether we should level off the top before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 我问把面粉倒进去之前需不需要「刮平顶部」。

collocations: level off the top of the cup
use a straight edge to level off the top

words.enDefinition: Brown sugar pressed into a measuring cup so it fills the space

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe called for packed brown sugar before measuring.
examples.zh: 我在量棕糖之前查了菜谱要不要用「压实量取的棕糖」。

examples.en: The tutor showed what packed brown sugar looks like when it is tipped out.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了倒出来的「压实量取的棕糖」是什么样。

collocations: a cup of packed brown sugar
a recipe calling for packed brown sugar

words.enDefinition: A small, informal amount of milk poured into something

examples.en: I added a splash of milk after testing the consistency of the batter.
examples.zh: 我试了下面糊的稠度，然后加了「少许牛奶」。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a splash of milk to make the mixture easier to stir.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求加「少许牛奶」，这样混合物更容易搅拌。

words.enDefinition: A small piece of butter measured by eye rather than weight

examples.en: The British recipe listed a knob of butter instead of giving a weight.
examples.zh: 这份英国菜谱写的是「一小块黄油」，没有注明重量。

examples.en: My roommate asked how much the recipe meant by a knob of butter.
examples.zh: 室友问，菜谱说的「一小块黄油」大概有多少。

collocations: a knob of butter for mixing

words.enDefinition: A small amount of oil poured in a thin stream

examples.en: The salad called for a drizzle of oil rather than a full spoonful.
examples.zh: 这份沙拉要用「少量淋上的油」，用不着满满一勺。

examples.en: We added a drizzle of oil before tasting the salad with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 和邻居一起尝沙拉之前，我们加了「少量淋上的油」。

collocations: finish with a drizzle of oil

words.enDefinition: One separate section of a whole bulb of garlic

examples.en: The recipe listed a clove of garlic next to the lemon juice.
examples.zh: 菜谱在柠檬汁旁边列了「一瓣大蒜」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether a clove of garlic was enough for the whole bowl.
examples.zh: 室友问这一整碗放「一瓣大蒜」够不够。

words.enDefinition: One small stem of thyme with leaves still attached

examples.en: The ingredients included a sprig of thyme as well as a little parsley.
examples.zh: 食材里除了少量欧芹，还有「一小枝百里香」。

examples.en: I asked what a recipe meant by a sprig of thyme when measuring herbs.
examples.zh: 量香草时，我问菜谱说的「一小枝百里香」是多大一枝。

words.enDefinition: Half the amount of food normally prepared in one batch

examples.en: We made half a batch because our bowl was the smallest one.
examples.zh: 我们用的是最小的碗，所以只做了「半批」。

examples.en: I asked if half a batch would be enough for our study group.
examples.zh: 我问做「半批」够不够我们学习小组吃。

words.enDefinition: The listed ingredients that have not yet been added

examples.en: I set out the remaining ingredients while my flatmate measured the flour.
examples.zh: 室友量面粉时，我摆好了「其余食材」。

examples.en: The next step tells us when to add the remaining ingredients.
examples.zh: 下个步骤会告诉我们什么时候加「其余食材」。

words.enDefinition: Amounts explicitly stated in an ingredient list or recipe

examples.en: I put all the listed quantities into one column on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我把所有「列明的用量」都填在了练习表的一栏。

examples.en: We followed the listed quantities when testing the recipe for class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上试做这个菜谱时，按的是「列明的用量」。

words.enDefinition: In whatever amount gives the flavor someone prefers

examples.en: The last line says we can add lemon juice to taste.
examples.zh: 最后一行说，柠檬汁可以「按个人口味」添加。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to add herbs to taste in the dressing.
examples.zh: 我问在酱汁里「按个人口味」放香草是怎么回事。

words.enDefinition: A deep container used for combining ingredients by hand or mixer

examples.en: I borrowed a mixing bowl because my usual bowl was too shallow.
examples.zh: 我常用的碗太浅，所以借了一个「搅拌碗」。

examples.en: The mixing bowl had enough space for all the salad ingredients.
examples.zh: 「搅拌碗」够大，装得下做沙拉的所有食材。

words.enDefinition: A cup with a known volume used to measure ingredients

examples.en: I borrowed a measuring cup before trying the recipe from my roommate.
examples.zh: 尝试室友给我的菜谱之前，我借了个「量杯」。

examples.en: One measuring cup in our set had markings that were hard to read.
examples.zh: 我们这套「量杯」里有一个的刻度不容易看清。

words.enDefinition: A spoon sized to measure small, specified ingredient volumes

examples.en: I found the measuring spoon in the drawer beside the teaspoons.
examples.zh: 我在放茶匙的抽屉里找到了「量勺」。

examples.en: My roommate asked which measuring spoon matched the amount in the recipe.
examples.zh: 室友问哪把「量勺」对应菜谱上的用量。

words.enDefinition: A marked container with space for measuring and pouring liquids

examples.en: I used the liquid measuring cup for the milk in the recipe.
examples.zh: 我用「液体量杯」量菜谱所需的牛奶。

examples.en: The liquid measuring cup had lines for both milliliters and fluid ounces.
examples.zh: 「液体量杯」上同时有毫升和液量盎司刻度。

words.enDefinition: A device used to measure the weight of food or ingredients

examples.en: The kitchen scale showed how much flour was still in the bowl.
examples.zh: 「厨房秤」显示碗里还剩多少面粉。

examples.en: I asked whether the student kitchen had a kitchen scale we could borrow.
examples.zh: 我问学生厨房有没有「厨房秤」可以借用。

collocations: weigh ingredients on a kitchen scale

words.enDefinition: A control that resets a scale while a container is on it

examples.en: The tare button was next to the display on our kitchen scale.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房秤上，「去皮归零键」就在显示屏旁边。

examples.en: I asked why the numbers changed after I pressed the tare button.
examples.zh: 我问为什么按下「去皮归零键」之后数字变了。

words.enDefinition: A flat board protecting a surface while food is cut

examples.en: I put our cutting board on the counter beside the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我把「切菜板」放在操作台上，就在蔬菜旁边。

examples.en: The cutting board was large enough for the whole loaf of bread.
examples.zh: 「切菜板」够大，放得下一整条面包。

words.enDefinition: A broad kitchen knife for many everyday cutting and chopping tasks

examples.en: My roommate asked which drawer held the chef's knife we share.
examples.zh: 室友问我们共用的「厨师刀」放在哪个抽屉里。

examples.en: The teacher showed us the difference between a chef's knife and a smaller knife.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了「厨师刀」和一把小刀有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A small kitchen knife used for trimming or peeling food

examples.en: I borrowed a paring knife to get the apples ready for class.
examples.zh: 我借了一把「削皮小刀」准备课堂上要用的苹果。

examples.en: The paring knife was in the drawer beside the vegetable peeler.
examples.zh: 「削皮小刀」在抽屉里，就放在蔬菜削皮器旁边。

words.enDefinition: A knife with a toothed edge designed for slicing bread

examples.en: I looked for a bread knife before our breakfast in the student kitchen.
examples.zh: 在学生厨房做早餐前，我找了找「面包刀」。

examples.en: My roommate put the bread knife next to the loaf on the board.
examples.zh: 室友把「面包刀」放在板上的面包旁边。

words.enDefinition: A small tool for removing thin skin from vegetables

examples.en: We found the vegetable peeler at the bottom of the utensil drawer.
examples.zh: 我们在厨具抽屉底部找到了「蔬菜削皮器」。

examples.en: I passed the vegetable peeler to my roommate when she started the carrots.
examples.zh: 室友开始准备胡萝卜时，我把「蔬菜削皮器」递给了她。

words.enDefinition: A box-shaped tool with different surfaces for shredding or grating

examples.en: The box grater has a different surface on each of its sides.
examples.zh: 「四方擦丝器」每一面都有不同的擦丝面。

examples.en: I borrowed a box grater from the flat next door for the cheese.
examples.zh: 我要擦奶酪，就从隔壁公寓借了一个「四方擦丝器」。

collocations: the coarse side of a box grater

words.enDefinition: A tool with small sharp openings for making fine shavings

examples.en: The recipe listed a fine grater among the equipment we needed.
examples.zh: 菜谱在所需用具中列了「细刨器」。

examples.en: My flatmate found the fine grater next to the measuring spoons.
examples.zh: 室友在量勺旁边找到了「细刨器」。

words.enDefinition: A tool made to remove the colored outer peel from citrus

examples.en: I asked whether the shared kitchen had a citrus zester for lemons.
examples.zh: 我问共用厨房有没有给柠檬用的「柑橘刨皮器」。

examples.en: The instructor showed us a citrus zester beside the other small tools.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了摆在其他小工具旁边的「柑橘刨皮器」。

words.enDefinition: A hand tool that crushes garlic by squeezing it through holes

examples.en: I found the garlic press in the drawer beside the peeler.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了「压蒜器」，就摆在削皮器旁边。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we had a garlic press for the dressing.
examples.zh: 室友问我们调酱汁时有没有「压蒜器」可用。

words.enDefinition: A device designed to squeeze juice from citrus fruits

examples.en: I borrowed a citrus juicer for the lemons we had bought.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「柑橘榨汁器」，用来榨我们买的柠檬。

examples.en: The citrus juicer was on the shelf next to the mixing bowls.
examples.zh: 「柑橘榨汁器」在架子上，放在搅拌碗旁边。

words.enDefinition: A tool that pushes the stones out of individual cherries

examples.en: The class supplied a cherry pitter for the fruit tart demonstration.
examples.zh: 做水果挞的演示课提供了一个「樱桃去核器」。

examples.en: I had never seen a cherry pitter before this baking workshop.
examples.zh: 这次烘焙讲座之前，我没见过「樱桃去核器」。

words.enDefinition: A tool that removes the central part of an apple

examples.en: The shared kitchen had an apple corer beside the fruit bowl.
examples.zh: 共用厨房的水果碗旁边有一个「苹果去核器」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the apple corer would fit the smaller apples.
examples.zh: 室友问「苹果去核器」适不适合这些较小的苹果。

words.enDefinition: A bowl with holes that lets liquid drain from food

examples.en: I left the pasta in a colander while finding a bowl.
examples.zh: 我把意面先放在「滤水篮」里，去找个碗。

examples.en: The colander was big enough for all of the salad leaves.
examples.zh: 「滤水篮」足够大，能放下做沙拉用的所有菜叶。

words.enDefinition: A strainer with very small openings for separating fine particles

examples.en: I borrowed a fine-mesh strainer for the little seeds in the dressing.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「细网滤筛」，用来滤掉酱汁里的小籽。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a fine-mesh strainer differed from a colander.
examples.zh: 老师解释了「细网滤筛」和滤水篮有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: A kitchen tool used to pass flour through a fine screen

examples.en: I found the flour sifter in our student kitchen's baking cupboard.
examples.zh: 我在学生厨房放烘焙用具的柜子里找到了「面粉筛」。

examples.en: The workshop displayed a flour sifter beside a bowl of flour.
examples.zh: 讲座把一个「面粉筛」摆在一碗面粉旁边。

words.enDefinition: A container that spins to remove water from salad leaves

examples.en: The salad spinner took up most of the space in the drawer.
examples.zh: 「沙拉蔬菜甩干器」占了抽屉大半的空间。

examples.en: I asked whether our flatmate had bought a salad spinner for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我问室友是不是给厨房买了一个「沙拉蔬菜甩干器」。

collocations: the basket of a salad spinner

words.enDefinition: A hand tool for crushing cooked potatoes or similar food

examples.en: I borrowed a potato masher for the filling we were making.
examples.zh: 我借了一个「土豆压泥器」，准备用来做馅。

examples.en: The potato masher was hanging above the counter in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 「土豆压泥器」挂在我们共用厨房的操作台上方。

words.enDefinition: A strong bowl and matching tool for crushing ingredients together

examples.en: The class had one mortar and pestle for every pair of students.
examples.zh: 课堂上给每两位学生配了一套「研钵和研杵」。

examples.en: We borrowed a mortar and pestle to prepare the dressing from the recipe.
examples.zh: 我们借了一套「研钵和研杵」，准备照菜谱调酱汁。

collocations: grind spices with a mortar and pestle

words.enDefinition: A whisk with wide loops that can incorporate air into mixtures

examples.en: The balloon whisk was too big for our smallest mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 「球形打蛋器」太大，放不进我们最小的搅拌碗。

examples.en: I chose a balloon whisk from the tools beside the recipe.
examples.zh: 我从菜谱旁边的用具里挑了一个「球形打蛋器」。

words.enDefinition: A flexible kitchen tool used to scrape or fold mixtures

examples.en: I used a silicone spatula to get the batter out of the bowl.
examples.zh: 我用「硅胶刮刀」把面糊从碗里刮出来。

examples.en: The silicone spatula was soft enough to bend against the bowl.
examples.zh: 「硅胶刮刀」很软，可以弯曲贴着碗壁。

words.enDefinition: A wooden utensil commonly used to stir or combine ingredients

examples.en: I mixed the dough with a wooden spoon from the shared drawer.
examples.zh: 我从共用抽屉里拿出一把「木勺」拌面团。

examples.en: My flatmate asked for a wooden spoon to mix the salad.
examples.zh: 室友要一把「木勺」拌沙拉。

words.enDefinition: A flat tool used to divide dough or clear a worktop

examples.en: The tutor left a bench scraper beside the dough for each group.
examples.zh: 老师在每组的面团旁边放了一个「面团刮板」。

examples.en: I borrowed a bench scraper to move the pieces onto the tray.
examples.zh: 我借了个「面团刮板」，把这些小块移到托盘上。

collocations: divide dough with a bench scraper

words.enDefinition: A cylindrical tool for flattening dough or pastry evenly

examples.en: I borrowed a rolling pin from the students in the next flat.
examples.zh: 我向隔壁公寓的同学借了根「擀面杖」。

examples.en: The rolling pin was too wide for the board we had.
examples.zh: 「擀面杖」比我们那块板还宽。

words.enDefinition: A circular tool for cutting rounds from rolled pastry dough

examples.en: I looked for a round pastry cutter that matched the size in the photo.
examples.zh: 我找了一支「圆形面团切模」，尺寸和菜谱照片上的一样。

examples.en: The tutor showed a round pastry cutter large enough for the tart bases.
examples.zh: 老师展示了一个够切挞底的「圆形面团切模」。

collocations: cut dough with a round pastry cutter

words.enDefinition: A hand tool that cuts cold fat into flour for pastry

examples.en: The instructor showed which tool was the pastry blender on our tray.
examples.zh: 老师指给我们看，托盘里哪个工具是「油面切拌器」。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether the recipe required a pastry blender for the dough.
examples.zh: 室友问照这个菜谱做面团是否一定要用「油面切拌器」。

collocations: cut butter with a pastry blender

words.enDefinition: A small kitchen brush used to apply liquids to food

examples.en: The recipe listed a pastry brush for coating the top of the pastry.
examples.zh: 菜谱列了一把「烘焙刷」，用来在酥皮表面刷涂。

examples.en: I found the pastry brush with the other baking tools in the drawer.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉里找到了「烘焙刷」，它和其他烘焙用具放在一起。

words.enDefinition: A flexible bag used to squeeze mixtures through a small opening

examples.en: I borrowed a piping bag for the frosting at our cake workshop.
examples.zh: 我在蛋糕课上借了一个「裱花袋」，用来挤糖霜。

examples.en: My flatmate held the piping bag while I checked the recipe photo.
examples.zh: 我核对菜谱照片时，室友拿着「裱花袋」。

words.enDefinition: A shaped nozzle that controls the mixture leaving a piping bag

examples.en: I picked a piping tip that matched the shape in the photo.
examples.zh: 我挑了一个和照片上形状一致的「裱花嘴」。

examples.en: The piping tip was in a small box beside the reusable bag.
examples.zh: 「裱花嘴」放在一个小盒子里，就在可重复使用的裱花袋旁边。

words.enDefinition: A curved mixer attachment designed to pull and work dough

examples.en: The dough hook was packed separately from the other mixer attachments.
examples.zh: 「和面钩」和搅拌机其他配件分开包装。

examples.en: I asked which attachment in the box was the dough hook.
examples.zh: 我问盒子里的哪个配件是「和面钩」。

words.enDefinition: A hinged utensil for lifting and mixing portions of salad

examples.en: I reached for the salad tongs beside the large mixing bowl.
examples.zh: 我伸手去拿大搅拌碗旁边的「沙拉夹」。

examples.en: The salad tongs helped me mix the salad without spilling leaves.
examples.zh: 「沙拉夹」帮我拌好了沙拉，没有把菜叶撒出来。

words.enDefinition: A board-shaped kitchen tool for cutting food into even slices

examples.en: The demo showed the mandoline slicer beside a tray of cucumber slices.
examples.zh: 演示时，「板式切片器」放在一盘黄瓜片旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether the mandoline slicer belonged to our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我问这个「板式切片器」是不是我们共用厨房的。

words.enDefinition: To divide an ingredient into four roughly equal pieces

examples.en: The recipe says that the apples should be cut into quarters for the platter.
examples.zh: 菜谱说，用来拼盘的苹果要「切成四等份」。

examples.en: I checked which vegetables had already been cut into quarters before measuring them.
examples.zh: 量之前，我核对了哪些蔬菜已经「切成四等份」。

words.enDefinition: A cup designed to measure dry ingredients level with the rim

examples.en: I reached for a dry measuring cup to measure the oats for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我拿了一个「干料量杯」量早餐要用的燕麦。

examples.en: The tutor showed one dry measuring cup beside a jug for liquids.
examples.zh: 老师把一个「干料量杯」摆在液体量杯旁边给我们看。

collocations: a set of dry measuring cups

words.enDefinition: A flexible tool shaped to remove mixture from inside a bowl

examples.en: I used a bowl scraper to move the dough onto the board.
examples.zh: 我用「碗用软刮板」把面团移到了板子上。

examples.en: The bowl scraper bent enough to follow the curve of our bowl.
examples.zh: 「碗用软刮板」能弯到贴合我们碗的弧度。

words.enDefinition: A spreading tool with a raised handle above its flat blade

examples.en: I used a small offset spatula for the frosting on our cake.
examples.zh: 我用了一把小「弯柄抹刀」给我们的蛋糕抹糖霜。

examples.en: The instructor set the offset spatula next to the cake for our group.
examples.zh: 老师把「弯柄抹刀」放在蛋糕旁边留给我们这组。

collocations: spread frosting with an offset spatula
